caseName: Church of Scientology Int'l v. Decrescenzo
caseNameFull: CHURCH OF SCIENTOLOGY INTERNATIONAL v. Laura Ann DeCRESCENZO

opinions.text: Motion of Rutherford Institute for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of National Council of Churches of Christ, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeal of California, Second Appellate District, denied.
